_metadata.description: Requirement stubs scaffolded from the P1 operational targets.

requirements.description: Add bounded, rate-aware, keyless readers for Bitcoin, Ethereum, Base, and Solana, including SPL transfers and Pump-style launch instructions; cache immutable source responses and expose pruned history, pagination, RPC, and address-history limitations.
requirements.title: Multi-chain public source coverage

validation.notes: Replay bounded recorded fixtures for BTC, Ethereum, Base, Solana native/SPL, and Pump program events; verify cache keys, rate-limit behavior, finality, source identity, and explicit partial-history errors.

requirements.description: Correlate Across and Wormhole from source and destination chain events, then produce reproducible exchange deposit clusters only when each rule has public source support, a version, a counter-explanation, an evidence grade, and an unresolved-gap record.
requirements.title: Bridge and cluster evidence

validation.notes: Replay independently sourced Across and Wormhole fixtures through correlation rules; verify event/message joins, versioned cluster rules, public exchange label provenance, counter-explanations, and grade boundaries.

requirements.description: Deliver a polished responsive case-review UI, documented Connect/API endpoints, stable CLI output, and useful loading, empty, error, partial-history, stale-provider, rate-limited, export, and privacy states; keep human labels separate from chain facts.
requirements.title: Investigator workflow

validation.notes: Run UI/API/CLI journeys at mobile and desktop sizes for loading, empty, error, partial-history, stale, rate-limited, privacy, and local-export states; validate typed responses and accessibility assertions.
